James Murphy

About the author

James Murphy is a Northern Irish crime writer whose work explores the darker corners of human nature through compelling detective fiction and psychological suspense. He is best known for the Farset Investigations Belfast detective series and the Dr. Carolyn Harkin psychological thriller series, which includes Write Me A Murder and How To Be Dead. His novels have been praised for their authentic portrayal of complex social issues, particularly violence against women and girls, combining emotional depth with tightly plotted, character-driven storytelling. Alongside his fiction, Murphy is committed to supporting and developing the crime writing community. He teaches crime fiction writing, mentors emerging writers, and is a regular speaker at literary festivals, libraries and cultural events across the UK and Ireland.
